summary: Empty database, signature capture, and PDF signature features fully tested and verified. Backend: 100% pass (9/9 tests). Frontend: All signature features working. Database confirmed empty on start (0 cases, 0 hospitals, 0 surgeons). Doctor profile signature capture buttons present with camera/gallery options. Signature persists in database and displays in profile preview. PDF HTML includes signature image via tag when doctor has signature_base64 set. Camera permissions properly configured in app.json for iOS and Android. App name is 'FAFT'. Fixed critical bug: duplicate drSig variable declaration in case/[id].tsx.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, should use 'boxShadow'
react_native_issues.note: Cosmetic warning only, not breaking functionality. Same as previous iterations.
